$comment: Golden signing vectors for the myGFO eTechLog. Any correct implementation must reproduce `canonical` and `sha256` byte-for-byte from `payload`. Regenerate with: node scripts/gen-signing-vectors.mjs
invariants: Object keys are sorted by UTF-16 code unit at every nesting level.
An omitted optional field and an explicit null are DIFFERENT payloads with different hashes.
Attachment digests are sorted ascending before hashing, so upload order is not covered.
Non-ASCII is emitted as UTF-8, never as \u escapes.
The client hash and the server recomputation must match exactly; on mismatch the commit is rejected, never re-hashed.
payloadExtra is opaque to a verifier but is covered by the hash; production should prefer structured fields.

vectors.note: Baseline CRS sign-off with an A&P certificate number present.

payload.intent: I certify this aircraft is approved for return to service with respect to the work performed.

vectors.canonical: {"certNumber":"A&P 3412887","entity":"MaintenanceRelease","entityId":"REL-2026-0417","intent":"I certify this aircraft is approved for return to service with respect to the work performed.","signedAtUtc":"2026-07-14T16:32:05.000Z","signerOid":"3f2a1b7c-9d4e-4a11-8c22-0b7d5e6f8a90","v":1}

vectors.note: certNumber is OMITTED, not null. The absent-vs-null distinction changes the bytes — see the null-cert case.

vectors.note: Non-ASCII must survive as UTF-8, not \u-escapes. A signer name with a diacritic and a non-Latin script.

vectors.note: Quote, backslash, newline, tab and a control character must use the RFC 8785 escape set exactly.

vectors.note: Numbers follow ES6 Number::toString — integers unsuffixed, no trailing zeros, exponent form above 1e21.

vectors.note: payloadExtra is opaque but IS covered by the hash — changing it changes the signature. Production should prefer structured `fields`.

payload.intent: I acknowledge the briefing disclosure shown.

vectors.note: PAIRED WITH pilot-acceptance-no-cert. Same payload but certNumber explicitly null — canonicalize KEEPS null and DROPS undefined, so this hash MUST differ. An implementation that emits null for a missing cert will silently produce unverifiable signatures.

vectors.canonical: {"certNumber":null,"entity":"FlightLog","entityId":"FL-2026-1188","intent":"I accept the aircraft for dispatch and acknowledge the open deferrals listed.","signedAtUtc":"2026-07-14T17:04:00.000Z","signerOid":"8c1d0e2f-4a5b-4c6d-9e70-1f2a3b4c5d6e","v":1}

vectors.note: Nested objects sort at every level; empty object and empty array are preserved distinctly.
RFC 8785 sorts by UTF-16 code unit, NOT by locale or code point. Uppercase sorts before lowercase; the astral character sorts by its surrogate pair.
